text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (April 18, 2024) for 325 Bogert Avenue

The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel: 1. Granted the request from the Appellant for an adjournment of the consideration of the Property Standards Order (April 18, 2024) for 325 Bogert Avenue, Folder Number: 24 136317 PRS 00 IV to its meeting on September 18, 2024. 2. Directed the Appellant to work with the Municipal Licensing and Standards Division to prepare and submit a comprehensive work plan and include a work time line for the Items listed on the Property Standards Order (April 18, 2024) for 325 Bogert Avenue, Folder Number: 24 136317 PRS 00 IV.
